messages:
sara: Hey team — GA customer (FinTech) asks for a fast tryout env. Need a short runflow/checklist we can run this afternoon. Top concerns: API keys, model pinning, cost cap, and security questionnaire items.

mike: I can own the infra steps. Do we want hosted API keys or spin a short-lived dedicated pool?

olivia: For an initial demo, hosted API + scoped API key usually wins for speed. If they insist on isolation we do a tiny Dedicated pool (1 GPU) as a follow-up.

kevin: Agreed. Hosted for T+0. Dedicated if they need guaranteed throughput or data isolation. We should still capture VPC requirements in case they escalate.

sara: Good. Can someone paste a quick onboarding checklist (what SEs need to run) and a customer-facing email template?

mike: Quick internal checklist (for hosted tryout):
- Confirm contact + admin email.
- Create a scoped API key with expiry (7 days) and route to sandbox models.
- Set org-level token quota and per-key daily cap.
- Pin model to a small open model (e.g., redwood-small-v1) and enable streaming off.
- Add cost/latency alert for >$X/day.

olivia: Customer email template (short):
"""
Hi [Name],
I've provisioned a temporary Redwood tryout environment for your team. Details:
- API key: scope=generate,expires=7d
- Base model: redwood-small-v1 (pinned)
- Rate caps: 60 rps, $X/day budget enforced

Try a quick curl below and paste any failing prompts.
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-v1","input":"Hello"}'
```
Best,
Olivia
"""

mike: Internal ACL steps if customer asks for Dedicated or Private later:
- Validate customer CIDR & peering plan.
- Collect allowed IPs and VPN termination details.
- Request KMS + log shipping details (SIEM endpoint).
- Create Dedicated pool ticket: include requested GPU flavor, burst policy, and SLOs.

kevin: Security questionnaire snippets we should reuse:
- Data residency: "We support region pinning; hosted regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1."
- Data retention: "Request-level logs retained 30 days by default; can be configured per-contract."
- Encryption: "TLS in transit; customer keys via KMS/HSM for Private deployments."
- Access controls: "Scoped API keys, role-based Console access, and audit logs."

sara: Nice. Can we add a short cost-estimate quick calc for Hosted vs Dedicated? The AE wants numbers to justify upsell.

mike: Hosted quick calc: average token cost = $0.0009/token (example). For 100k tokens/day -> ~$90/day. Dedicated: fixed pool $X/hr + much lower per-token compute. I'll attach actual pricing sheet in the ticket.

devops-bot: Created ticket #POC-4123 — Dedicated pool request template attached.

olivia: One more ops trick: enable prefix caching for the demo prompts (reduces tokens billed). Put a small prompt harness in the repo and share link in the email.

kevin: Answering common security Qs: have SOC2 + network diagram ready. If they require pen test, route to Security for statement of scope.

sara: Perfect — mike, can you create the hosted API key and send the email draft? Olivia, please add the prompt harness link. I'll update the pricing line and forward the security checklist.

mike: On it, will post when done.

olivia: Linking harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tryout-harness (demo prompts + caching flags).

sara: Thanks all — closing this thread when email sent. :thumbsup:
